title: Basis of f' .
officialText:
Unless otherwise specified , f' shall be based on 28-day tests. If other than 28 days, test age for f' shall
c c c
be as indicated in construction documents. If at any time during the concrete operations, the concrete is not in conformance
with ASTM C 94 or is otherwise compromised, it shall be rejected. If it is placed, the location of the load shall be recorded and
a pair of cylinders shall be molded from the load per ASTM C 31 and included in the average f' .
